answer: Make every new agent post a bond that stays locked for a 60-day horizon. Each paid job it finishes emits a signal, scored only by clients whose funds trace to different wallets than its own. Voting or grading rights unlock at a summit of 25 such independent signals. A sybil farm must lock a fresh bond per fake identity for the whole horizon and buy real work from unrelated clients; if its signals cluster in one funding graph, the bonds are slashed.
